# Setup
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")


library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(Seurat)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

basedir <- here("species/mmus/zwick")
genomedir <- here("species/mmus/genome")
datadir <- "~/Dropbox/research/resources/datasets/zwick-smint/GSM6077219"

source(here(basedir, "code/utilities_ggplot.R"))
source(here(basedir, "code/utilities_seurat-plots.R"))
```


```{r}
plot_dotplot2 <- function(
    .obj,
    .features,
    .cluster_order,
    .title,
    .reorder_genes = FALSE
) {
  xx <- dp_extract_dotplot_data(.obj = .obj, .features = .features) %>%
    dp_define_cluster_order(.cluster_order = .cluster_order)
  
  if (.reorder_genes) {
    xx <- dp_define_feature_order(xx)
  }
  
  xx %>%
    dp_split_dotplot_data() %>%
    purrr::map(dp_plot) %>%
    purrr::map(dp_add_title, .title = .title)
}

define_cluster_order <- function(.obj) {
  hcc <- .obj %>%
    AggregateExpression(
      return.seurat = TRUE,
      features = VariableFeatures(.obj)
    ) %>%
    ScaleData() %>%
    GetAssayData(layer = "scale.data") %>%
    cor() %>%
    dist() %>%
    hclust()
  
  hcc$labels[hcc$order]
}

add_prefix_to_idents <- function(.obj, .cluster.name, .prefix) {
  old_levels <- levels(.obj[[.cluster.name, drop = TRUE]])
  .obj[[.cluster.name]] <- paste0(.prefix, .obj[[.cluster.name, drop = TRUE]])
  .obj[[.cluster.name]] <- factor(
    .obj[[.cluster.name, drop = TRUE]],
    paste0(.prefix, old_levels)
  )
  .obj <- SetIdent(.obj, value = .cluster.name)
  return(.obj)
}
```


# Zwick et al data

```{r}
cts <- Matrix::readMM(here(datadir, "GSM6077219_IEC_matrix.mtx.gz"))
barcodes <- read.table(here(datadir, "GSM6077219_IEC_barcodes.tsv.gz"))
features <- read.table(here(datadir, "GSM6077219_IEC_features.tsv.gz"))

seg <- read.table(here(datadir, "GSM6077219_IEC_mux_barcode_segment.tsv.gz"))
seg <- rownames_to_column(seg, "cell")
seg$barcode <- NULL

if (length(barcodes$V1) == ncol(cts)) {
  colnames(cts) <- barcodes$V1
} else {
  stop()
}

if (length(features$V1) == nrow(cts)) {
  rownames(cts) <- features$V1
} else {
  stop()
}

# If there are fewer cells in metadata than in mtx
cts_md <- cts[, seg$cell]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(cts_md), features$V1))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(cts_md), seg$cell))

mm <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = cts_md, meta.data = seg)
```


```{r}
mm$domain <- case_when(
  mm$segment %in% c("1", "2") ~ "A",
  mm$segment %in% c("3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8", "9") ~ "B",
  mm$segment %in% c("10", "11", "12", "13", "14", "15", "16", "17") ~ "C",
  mm$segment %in% c("18", "19", "20", "21", "22", "23", "24") ~ "D",
  mm$segment %in% c("25", "26", "27", "28", "29", "30") ~ "E",
  .default = NA_character_
)

mm <- mm |>
  NormalizeData() |>
  FindVariableFeatures() |>
  ScaleData() |>
  RunPCA(npcs = 30) |>
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30) |> 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30) |>
  FindClusters()
```

```{r}
mm <- add_prefix_to_idents(mm, "seurat_clusters", "g")
mm_clust_order <- define_cluster_order(mm)

markers <- FindAllMarkers(mm, only.pos = TRUE)
```
```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 11

markers |> 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) |> 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 1) |> 
  group_by(cluster) |> 
  slice_head(n = 5) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  pull(gene) |> 
  unique() |> 
  (function(x) {
    plot_dotplot2(mm, x, mm_clust_order, "Top markers", TRUE)
  })()
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
DimPlot(mm, label = TRUE)
```

# Remove obvious non-enterocyte clusters

We need only enterocytes for our analysis, particularly mature enterocytes

```{r}
ec1 <- subset(mm, idents = c("g1", "g3", "g4", "g5", "g6", "g8", "g12"))
```

```{r}
ec1 <- ec1 |>
  NormalizeData() |>
  FindVariableFeatures() |>
  ScaleData() |>
  RunPCA(npcs = 30) |>
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30) |> 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30) |>
  FindClusters() |> 
  add_prefix_to_idents("seurat_clusters", "ec")

ec1_clust_order <- define_cluster_order(ec1)
```

```{r}
markers_ec1 <- FindAllMarkers(ec1, only.pos = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 11

markers_ec1 |> 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) |> 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 1) |> 
  group_by(cluster) |> 
  slice_head(n = 4) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  pull(gene) |> 
  unique() |> 
  (function(x) {
    plot_dotplot2(ec1, x, ec1_clust_order, "Top markers", TRUE)
  })()
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 10


DimPlot(ec1, label = TRUE) +
  DimPlot(ec1, group.by = "domain")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 10

DimPlot(ec1, label = TRUE, reduction = "pca") +
  DimPlot(ec1, reduction = "pca", group.by = "domain") 
```

```{r}
positional_genes <- c("Meis2", "Otop3", "Sult6b2", "Fth1", "Fabp1", "Ces1f", "Papss2", "Adh1", "Slc2a2", "Dgat2", "Duoxa2", "Slc10a2", "Suox", "Cd74", "Apoa4", "Plb1", "Fabp6", "Glud1", "Rpl13")
```


# Pseudobulk data

```{r}
ec1_ps <- AggregateExpression(ec1, group.by = "domain", return.seurat = TRUE) |> 
  GetAssayData(layer = "data") |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column("gene") |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  arrange(gene)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 7

ec1_ps |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -gene, names_to = "domain", values_to = "norm_exp") |> 
  filter(gene %in% positional_genes) |> 
  ggplot(aes(domain, norm_exp, group = gene)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(vars(gene), scales = "free_y") 
```


# Write data 

```{r}
write_rds(ec1, here(basedir, "data/enterocytes.rds"), compress = "gz")
write_csv(ec1_ps, here(basedir, "data/enterocytes_agg-by-domain.csv"))
```
